terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: What you agree to when you use this site or commission work from Dwi Studio.

sections.heading: Who you are dealing with
sections.body: Dwi Studio is a one-person design and development practice in Banjarmasin, Indonesia, run by M. Dwi Cahya Winantio. Everything on this site is written, designed, and built by one hand.

sections.heading: Using this site
sections.body: Read it, share it, link to it. The writing, photographs, code, and design belong to the studio - do not republish them as your own, and ask first before using them to train a model.

sections.heading: Prices are starting points
sections.body: The figures on the Services page are where projects start, not fixed quotes. A real quote follows a conversation about what you need, and it names the scope, the timeline, and the price before any work begins.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Projects open with a deposit and settle on handover unless we agree otherwise in writing. The exact terms live in your quote, not on this page.

sections.heading: Revisions and timelines
sections.body: Every quote states how many revision rounds it includes. Timelines assume your content and feedback arrive when they are due; if they arrive late, the delivery date moves by the same amount.

sections.heading: Who owns the finished work
sections.body: Once the final invoice is paid, the work is yours. The studio keeps the right to show it in its portfolio unless you ask otherwise. Third-party fonts, photography, and plugins stay under their own licences, which the quote names.

sections.heading: What you provide
sections.body: You are responsible for the text, images, and logos you send, and for holding the rights to use them.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.body: Work is built carefully and tested before it ships, but no site can be guaranteed free of faults or downtime. The studio is not liable for indirect or consequential loss. Nothing here removes rights you hold under Indonesian consumer law.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms can change. The date at the top tells you when they last did, and a change never applies backwards to work already quoted.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Write through the contact page. The reply comes from the studio, not a helpdesk.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What this site collects, why it collects it, and how long it is kept.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body: No advertising, no tracking pixels, no third-party analytics. The only personal data this site collects is what you type into the contact form.

sections.heading: What the contact form collects
sections.body: Your name, email address, subject, and message - with the date it arrived and whether it has been read. Nothing else is stored, and nothing is inferred about you.

sections.heading: Why it is collected
sections.body: To read your message and answer it. That is the only purpose. Your details are never sold, never shared with anyone else, and never used for marketing.

sections.heading: How long it is kept
sections.body: Messages are kept while the conversation is still useful and deleted when it is not. Ask for yours to be deleted sooner and it will be.

sections.heading: Where it is stored
sections.body: In this site's own database, on hosting the studio controls. The hosting provider processes it on the studio's behalf and under contract, and uses it for nothing else.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Browsing the public site sets no cookies. A session cookie exists only inside the admin area, which is for the studio's own sign-in - not for visitors.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask what is held about you, ask for a copy, ask for a correction, or ask for it to be deleted. Write in and it will be acted on.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Reach the studio through the contact page.
